svg.title: What DoViFixer does to a Profile 7 video
svg.desc: Animation. DoViFixer keeps the base layer exactly as it is, converts the RPU metadata from Profile 7 to Profile 8.1 and takes the enhancement layer out. You can keep the enhancement layer in a small .dovi backup file and restore the original Profile 7 video later. The result is a Profile 8.1 video that streaming boxes play in Dolby Vision.

g.text: Optional: EL kept in a small backup file
✓ Plays in Dolby Vision on streaming boxes
